_meta.description: 多步骤数据需求工作流

workflow.name: 指定店铺PMV分析-按支付方式细分
workflow.description: 分析需求方提供的店铺列表在指定年份的线下PMV，按支付方式（储值卡/标记支付/现金）细分统计
workflow.business_pattern: 数据需求处理通用流程

input.kdt_id_list: 需求方提供的店铺ID列表
input.time_range: 需求方指定的时间范围（如 pay_years='2025'）
input.filters: 需求方指定的筛选条件

output.final_table: 最终结果表，用于导出给需求方

steps.name: 整理店铺信息
steps.description: 根据需求方提供的kdt_id列表，创建店铺清单表
steps.sql_template:
CREATE TABLE {target_table} AS
SELECT kdt_id, team_name, hq_kdt_id, hq_team_name, shop_role_name, product, open_status_name
FROM {source_table}
WHERE kdt_id IN ({kdt_id_list})

steps.name: 支付明细范围过滤
steps.description: 按时间范围和店铺列表过滤支付明细，排除重复支付
steps.sql_template:
CREATE TABLE {target_table} AS
SELECT a.*
FROM {source_table} a
WHERE pay_years = '{year}'
  AND kdt_id IN (SELECT kdt_id FROM {shop_list_table})
  AND pay_is_repeated = '否'

steps.name: 线下GMV/PMV汇总
steps.sql_template:
CREATE TABLE {target_table} AS
SELECT kdt_id,
       SUM(gmv_amount) AS offline_gmv,
       SUM(pmv_amount) AS offline_pmv
FROM {source_table}
WHERE offline_tag = '线下'
GROUP BY kdt_id

steps.name: 单笔>5万统计
steps.description: 统计线下单笔大于5万的GMV（需求方指定条件）
steps.sql_template:
CREATE TABLE {target_table} AS
SELECT kdt_id, SUM(gmv_amount) AS 5w_gmv
FROM {source_table}
WHERE gmv_amount > 5000000
  AND offline_tag = '线下'
GROUP BY kdt_id

steps.name: 支付方式细分
steps.description: 按储值卡/标记支付/现金支付方式统计GMV
steps.sql_template:
CREATE TABLE {target_table} AS
SELECT kdt_id,
       pay_method_name,
       SUM(gmv_amount) AS p_gmv
FROM {source_table}
WHERE offline_tag = '线下'
  AND (pay_tool_name IN ('标记支付', '现金支付') OR pay_method_name = '储值卡支付')
GROUP BY kdt_id, pay_method_name

steps.name: 最终结果表
steps.description: 关联所有中间表，生成最终宽表用于导出
steps.sql_template:
CREATE TABLE {target_table} AS
SELECT a.*,
       b.offline_gmv,
       b.offline_pmv,
       c.5w_gmv,
       d1.p_gmv AS card_gmv,
       d2.p_gmv AS mark_gmv,
       d3.p_gmv AS cash_gmv
FROM {shop_list_table} a
LEFT JOIN {step3_table} b ON a.kdt_id = b.kdt_id
LEFT JOIN {step4_table} c ON a.kdt_id = c.kdt_id
LEFT JOIN {step5_table} d1 ON d1.kdt_id = a.kdt_id AND d1.pay_method_name = '储值卡支付'
LEFT JOIN {step5_table} d2 ON d2.kdt_id = a.kdt_id AND d2.pay_method_name = '标记支付'
LEFT JOIN {step5_table} d3 ON d3.kdt_id = a.kdt_id AND d3.pay_method_name = '现金支付'

key_concepts.kdt_id: 店铺唯一ID，需求方提供的核心参数
key_concepts.offline_tag: 支付场景标签，线上/线下
key_concepts.pay_is_repeated: 是否重复支付，通常过滤'否'
